plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Scam Detector PNG uses your approximate location (rounded to about 1 km) to place your scam report on the community map. You can report without sharing your location.

plugins.cameraPermission: Scam Detector PNG uses the camera to read QR codes so it can check the link inside before you open it. No photos are saved or uploaded.
